content_sections.heading: SVNIT Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SVNIT Teaching Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 27-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SVNIT Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to send the soft copy of your application via email is 27 August 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Teaching Assistant post at SVNIT?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a 1st Class or equivalent CGPA (Min 6.5/10) in M.Tech/M.E. and B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics Engineering. For PhD holders, a 1st Class or equivalent CGPA in B.Tech/B.E. and M.Tech/M.E. is also required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Teaching Assistant position ranges from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 60,000 per month, depending on the qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the SVNIT Teaching Assistant jobs?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Teaching Assistant role at SVNIT?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves Document Verification, a Written Test, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this Teaching Assistant position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Teaching Assistant position is Ad-hoc.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the walk-in interview date for the SVNIT Teaching Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Teaching Assistant position is scheduled to be held on 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of SVNIT?
faq.answer: The official website of Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology (SVNIT) is www.svnit.ac.in. You can visit this site for more information about the institute.
